utility.name: Hackerbot Client
utility.author: Z. Cliffe Schreuders
utility.description: Configures a VM to accept SSH connections from Hackerbot using key-based authentication. Installs the Hackerbot public key into /root/.ssh/authorized_keys, ensures correct permissions, and makes sure openssh-server is installed and running. Root login by key relies on Debian's default sshd setting (PermitRootLogin prohibit-password); the module does not edit sshd_config.
